                break

            y = 0.05 + (i + 0.5) * (0.9 / rows)

        circles[i, 1] = y  # y
        # Conservative initial radius to allow for better optimization
        min_dist_to_edge = min(x, 1-x, y, 1-y)
        # Use a moderate initial radius to allow for both expansion and fine-tuning
        circles[i, 2] = min(0.06, min_dist_to_edge * 0.75)

        return np.sum(circles[:, 2])

                (1 - circles[i, 2]) < circles[i, 0] or

                dist = np.sqrt((circles[i, 0] - circles[j, 0])**2 + 
                             (circles[i, 1] - circles[j, 1])**2)
                if dist < (circles[i, 2] + circles[j, 2]):
                    return False
        return True
